description: Resolve ChimpVibe tags to install or inspect exact builds, and contribute to admitted native games or start independent games through private Drafts. Follow the live MCP guide; the owner alone reviews and publishes.

CHIMPVIBE_TOKEN.title: ChimpVibe member token
CHIMPVIBE_TOKEN.description: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Set it in Cursor on the plugin's Configure page. Do not paste it into chat.
